pyproject:
[project]
name = "onfly-report"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "Consolidador de reservas de hotel da Onfly"
requires-python = ">=3.11"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
target-version = "py311"
src = ["src"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
addopts = "-ra"
